title: Catering Business for Sale in Bengaluru, India
tagline: The business operates five central kitchens in Bengaluru and serves 36 institutional clients. - It supplies around 18,000 meals daily, with reported kitchen utilisation of 40%, indicating potential to increase output using existing capacity. - Five major institutional clients contribute 88% of customer sales, with the largest account contributing 28%. - The promoters bring over two decades of business and HR management experience. - The business has GST and FSSAI license.
